metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1991 · Dinosaurs
metas.description: This show follows the life of a family of dinosaurs, living in a modern world. They have televisions, refrigerators, et cetera. The only humans around are cavemen, who are viewed as pets and wild animals.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1994 · The Kingdom
metas.description: Doctors at an ultramodern hospital in Denmark become convinced, by way of weird, inexplicable happenings, that the place is haunted.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1964 · The Munsters
metas.description: A family of friendly monsters have misadventures, never quite understanding why people react to them so strangely.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1990 · Are You Afraid of the Dark?
metas.description: A group of teenagers meet in the woods, and tell scary stories.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1995 · The Outer Limits
metas.description: "The Outer Limits" is a science fiction anthology series, with Kevin Conway providing the voice of "Control Voice".

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1985 · The Twilight Zone
metas.description: Tales of science fiction, fantasy and the occult.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 1968 · Mister Rogers' Neighborhood
metas.description: Fred Rogers explores various topics for young viewers through presentations and music, both in his world and in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1969 · Night Gallery
metas.description: Rod Serling presents tales of horror illustrated in various paintings.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1990 · Parker Lewis Can't Lose
metas.description: For a cool high-school kid and his friends, thwarting authority figures and other enemies is never a problem.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1997 · Beyond Belief: Fact or Fiction
metas.description: Five mysterious stories are shown in which people meet strange or unexplainable events. The viewer is invited to decide if the stories are fact or fiction.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1966 · Dark Shadows
metas.description: The rich Collins family of Collinsport, Maine is tormented by strange occurrences.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1984 · Robin of Sherwood
metas.description: A forest mystical being appoints two men in succession as the legendary outlaw defender of the oppressed.
